description: This file defines the FavoritesController class for handling favorite articles via API endpoints in an ASP.NET Core application. It provides actions for adding and removing article favorites, leveraging MediatR for request handling.

classes.name: FavoritesController
classes.description: Controller managing favorite article operations via HTTP POST and DELETE methods.

methods.name: FavoriteAdd
methods.description: Handles adding an article to favorites by slug, using MediatR to send the Add command.

methods.name: FavoriteDelete
methods.description: Handles removing an article from favorites by slug, using MediatR to send the Delete command.
